scope: Exploratory exact count-filter with approximate search-based action likelihoods. First four color-swapped pairs sorted(pair,red) from archived unchanged-teacher vs AB-JChess games, two earliest ambiguous teacher decisions per game, max32hypotheses. These OLD baseline trajectories become development diagnostics, not independent confirmations for any new belief method. One CPU thread, Hash16MB, quantized original NNUE, cold hash for EVERY forced root move at fixed depth2. Softmax(score/200), epsilon0.1 mixture per hypothesis over same public native positional-legal mask. UCI mate maps to sign*(32000-2*abs(mate)); mate0 treated as loss. FEN resets check/chase/repetition history, and timed/deeper actual teacher differs: likelihood is a declared approximation, not actual behavioral policy or equilibrium belief. Captured-type truth/setup seed are projected out before public reconstruction; seeded labels read only after prediction/update. No training, game-strength or novelty claim.

summary.warning: Correlated sparse reused baseline trajectories. Fixed-depth/history-reset soft search policy approximates a timed/history-aware engine. Not independent calibration or playing strength.
